mentions.name: MediaReduce
mentions.description: An image compliance platform for e-commerce sellers that validates product images against the requirements of Shopify, Etsy, Amazon and other marketplaces, consolidating the process so businesses don't have to switch between separate tools.
mentions.problem: Businesses currently switch between multiple tools to meet different marketplaces' image requirements.
mentions.audience: businesses selling on Shopify, Etsy, and Amazon marketplaces
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building Shopify, Etsy, Amazon and marketplace image compliance platform so that businesses don't switch between tools.

evidence.value: I am building Shopify, Etsy, Amazon and marketplace image compliance platform so that businesses don't switch between tools.
